##~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
##                      TreeAlert Scenario B Example
##~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Libraries
```{r, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(readr); library(tidyr); library(feasts) # Data
library(tsibble); library(fable); library(fabletools) # Forecasting
library(dplyr); library(lubridate) # Wrangling
library(ggplot2); library(ggtext); library(grid); library(gridExtra) # Plotting
library(slider); library(scales); library(rpart); library(rpart.plot);
ta_root <- c(".", "..", "../..")
ta_root <- ta_root[file.exists(file.path(ta_root, "TA_functions", "TA_functions.R"))][1]
source(file.path(ta_root, "TA_functions", "TA_functions.R"), local = TRUE)
source(file.path(ta_root, "TA_functions", "Rephrase_Rule_Func.R"), local = TRUE)
# library(caret)
```

Configuration
```{r}
# Scenario B ARIMA forecast-residual analysis.
analysis_choice_label <- "scenario_b"
analysis_target_label <- "ARIMA Forecast Error"
lift_metric <- "rmse"
simulation_output_prefix <- "scenario_b"

n_groups <- 20
n_rules <- 3
minute_increment <- NULL

baseline_formula <- .resid ~ WeekofYear + Month
fixed_formula <- .resid ~ WeekofYear + Month
final_formula <- fixed_formula

param_grid <- expand.grid(
  cp        = c(0, 0.00001, 0.0001, 0.0005),
  minbucket = seq(4, 8, by = 1),
  maxdepth  = seq(1, 8, by = 1)
)
```

Load Data
```{r, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
simulation_dir <- if (dir.exists("Simulation_Scenario_B")) "Simulation_Scenario_B" else ".."
simulation_image_dir <- file.path(simulation_dir, "images")
simulation_results_dir <- file.path(simulation_dir, "results")
dir.create(simulation_image_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(simulation_results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
source(file.path(simulation_dir, "code", "generate_actual_and_forecasts_data.R"))
series_path <- file.path(simulation_dir, "data", "scenario_b_actual_forecast_series.csv")
if (!file.exists(series_path)) {
  generate_actual_and_forecasts_data(seed = representative_seed, write_output = TRUE)
}
analysis_data <- readr::read_csv(series_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = as.Date(Time),
    WeekofYear = factor(as.character(WeekofYear), levels = as.character(1:53))
  )
```

Prepare Data
```{r}
# Data preparation is performed in generate_actual_and_forecasts_data.R.
# It creates the temporal predictors and assigns the prepared series to analysis_data above.
```

Train/Test Split
```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Chronological split: fourteen years for training and three years for testing.
training_end <- as.Date("2023-12-31")
test_start <- as.Date("2024-01-01")

train_set <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(Time <= training_end, is.finite(.resid))
test_set <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(Time >= test_start, is.finite(.resid))

# The daily process is aggregated to weekly observations before TreeAlert is fitted.
stopifnot(nrow(train_set) > 300L, nrow(test_set) > 100L)

#------------Calculate Theta - Top / bottom 5% of data ------------
top_5_percent <- quantile(train_set$.resid, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
bottom_5_percent <- quantile(train_set$.resid, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
top_5_percent_value <- top_5_percent[[1]] 
bottom_5_percent_value <- bottom_5_percent[[1]]
top_5_percent_value ; bottom_5_percent_value 
```

Grid Search
```{r}
## ============================================================================
## GRID SEARCH: Optimize Tree Parameters ONLY
## Fixed Predictors:
## Day + WeekofMonth + WeekofYear + Month
## Using SAME Lift Metric
## ============================================================================

# RUN GRID SEARCH
set.seed(representative_seed)
grid_search_formula <- .resid ~ WeekofYear + Month
grid_search <- tree_alert_grid_search(
  train_set = train_set,
  formula = grid_search_formula,
  param_grid = param_grid,
  n_groups = n_groups,
  pred_col_name = "Pred_Temp",
  lift_metric = lift_metric
)

# SELECT BEST MODEL
results <- grid_search$results
best_params <- grid_search$best_params

cat("\n=============================\n")
cat("  BEST TREE PARAMETERS FOUND\n")
cat("=============================\n")
print(best_params)
```

Final Model
```{r}
final_formula <- .resid ~ WeekofYear + Month
cat("  FINAL MODEL FORMULA USED\n")
print(final_formula)

# Train final rpart model
best_tree_model <- tree_alert_train_best_model(
  train_set = train_set,
  formula = final_formula,
  best_params = best_params
)

# Display tree rules
cat("\n=============================\n")
cat("        FINAL TREE RULES\n")
cat("=============================\n")
tree_rules <- rpart.rules(best_tree_model, cover = FALSE, digits = 4, nn = FALSE)
#print(tree_rules)

# Attach predicted leaf node averages to full dataset
leaf_nodes <- predict(best_tree_model, newdata = analysis_data, type = "vector")
analysis_data_with_leaf <- dplyr::bind_cols(analysis_data, Leaf_Node = leaf_nodes)

# Preview result
cat("\n=============================\n")
cat(" ATTACHED LEAF NODE PREDICTIONS\n")
cat("=============================\n")
print(head(analysis_data_with_leaf))
```

Final Lift Charts
```{r}
# ---- Compute lift for BEST MODEL ----
best_train <- tree_alert_compute_lift(
  train_set, best_tree_model, "Pred_Best", "Best Model (Train)",
  plot = TRUE, n_groups = n_groups,
  lift_label = "First Ventile",
  lift_metric = lift_metric,
  axis_title_size = 20, axis_text_x_size = 18, axis_text_y_size = 20
)
ggsave(file.path(simulation_image_dir, "scenario_b_lift_train.png"),
       plot = last_plot(), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 1000, bg = "white")
best_test <- tree_alert_compute_lift(
  test_set, best_tree_model, "Pred_Best", "Best Model (Test)",
  plot = TRUE, n_groups = n_groups,
  lift_label = "First Ventile",
  lift_metric = lift_metric,
  axis_title_size = 20, axis_text_x_size = 18, axis_text_y_size = 20
)
ggsave(file.path(simulation_image_dir, "scenario_b_lift_test.png"),
       plot = last_plot(), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 1000, bg = "white")
```

Top Rules
```{r}
# Refit the current model before extracting rules. This keeps the chunk
# consistent when it is run interactively after an earlier model is still in
# the session, and ensures that the factor-encoded WeekofYear is used.
set.seed(representative_seed)
grid_search <- tree_alert_grid_search(
  train_set = train_set,
  formula = grid_search_formula,
  param_grid = param_grid,
  n_groups = n_groups,
  pred_col_name = "Pred_Temp",
  lift_metric = lift_metric
)
results <- grid_search$results
best_params <- grid_search$best_params
best_tree_model <- tree_alert_train_best_model(
  train_set = train_set,
  formula = final_formula,
  best_params = best_params
)
tree_rules <- rpart.rules(best_tree_model, cover = FALSE, digits = 4, nn = FALSE)
leaf_nodes <- predict(best_tree_model, newdata = analysis_data, type = "vector")
analysis_data_with_leaf <- dplyr::bind_cols(analysis_data, Leaf_Node = leaf_nodes)

# ------------Pull top sorted terminal-node rules------------
rule_selection <- tree_alert_pull_top_k_rules(
  tree_rules = tree_rules,
  n_rules = n_rules
)
tree_rules <- rule_selection$tree_rules
selected_rules <- rule_selection$selected_rules
selected_rule_values <- rule_selection$selected_rule_values
rule_text_output <- tree_alert_list_top_rules(
  selected_rules = selected_rules,
  minute_increment = NULL
)

scenario_b_rule_output <- tibble(
  rule = seq_along(rule_text_output$raw_rules),
  raw_rule = rule_text_output$raw_rules,
  interpretation = rule_text_output$interpreted_rules
)

print(scenario_b_rule_output)
write_csv(
  scenario_b_rule_output,
  file.path(simulation_results_dir, "scenario_b_top_rules.csv")
)
```

Rule Plots
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#------------Filter the rows for each rule for plotting------------
list_of_dfs <- list() # Create an empty DataFrame to store the results
rule_coverage <- data.frame()
for (i in seq_along(selected_rule_values)) {

  # Pull the next sorted rule value to filter observations for plotting
  current_rule <- as.numeric(selected_rule_values[[i]])
  # round both to common decimal as analysis_data_with_leaf has more precision
  precision <- 2
  # Filter analysis_data_with_leaf
  filtered_data <- analysis_data_with_leaf %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(round(Leaf_Node, precision) == round(current_rule, precision))
  
  rule_coverage <- bind_rows(
    rule_coverage,
    data.frame(
      rule = i,
      train_points = sum(filtered_data$Time < min(test_set$Time, na.rm = TRUE)),
      test_points = sum(filtered_data$Time >= min(test_set$Time, na.rm = TRUE)),
      total_points = nrow(filtered_data)
    )
  )
  
  constructed_sentence <- rule_text_output$raw_rules[i]
  rule_text <- textGrob(constructed_sentence, gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 9))
  
  #------------Plot of filtered rules on fitted time scale------------
  post_rules_scatter_plot <- ggplot(filtered_data, 
                                    aes(x = Time, y = .resid)) + 
    geom_point(aes(color = .resid > 10)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = format(Time, "%H:%M")), 
              hjust = -0.1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2) +  # Adding time labels
  labs(title = paste("Scatter Plot of", analysis_target_label), x = "Time", y = analysis_target_label) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#FF0000", "TRUE" = "#9400D3"))
  #------------Create Residual Plot------------
  #Initiate arguments
  #shape_number <- ifelse(row <= 25, row, 20)
  random_color <- rgb(runif(1), runif(1), runif(1), maxColorValue = 255)
  list_of_dfs[[i]] <- filtered_data # used to save df's for lower plot.
  # Plot of filtered rules on full series
  post_rules_line_plot <- ggplot(analysis_data, 
                                 aes(x = Time, y = .resid)) +
    geom_line(color = "#00BFC4") +
    geom_point(data = filtered_data, 
               aes(x = Time, y = .resid,
                   color = .resid >= top_5_percent_value | .resid <= bottom_5_percent_value,
                   shape = .resid >= top_5_percent_value | .resid <= bottom_5_percent_value),
                   size = 2.5, stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = color_string[i], 
                                  "TRUE" = color_string[i])) +  
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 16)) +
    labs(title = paste(analysis_target_label, "Plot with Tree Filtered Extreme and Non-extreme Values",
                       sep=""), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = min(test_set$Time, na.rm = TRUE), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") + 
    theme(plot.title = element_markdown())
    #------------Plot of Actual Vs Predicted------------
  actual_predicted_plot <- ggplot(analysis_data, aes(x = Time)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Value, color = "Actual"), show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = filtered_data, 
               aes(x = Time, y = Value, 
      shape = .resid >= top_5_percent_value | .resid <= bottom_5_percent_value,
      color = .resid >= top_5_percent_value | .resid <=bottom_5_percent_value),
                   size = 2.5, stroke = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +  
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = color_string[i], 
                                  "FALSE" = color_string[i], 
                                  "Actual" = "#4682B4"),
                       guide = FALSE) + 
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 16)) +  
    labs(title = "<span style='color:#4682B4'><b>Actual</b>
         </span> Simulated Demand + Tree Filtered Points",
         x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Variable") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = min(test_set$Time, na.rm = TRUE), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_markdown())

   # Output plots
    grid.newpage()
    grid.draw(arrangeGrob(rule_text, post_rules_scatter_plot, ncol = 1))
    grid.newpage()
    grid.draw(arrangeGrob(post_rules_line_plot, actual_predicted_plot,
                 ncol = 1, heights = c(10,10)))
}

print(rule_coverage)
```

All Rules Plots
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# The analysis series is weekly, so retain weekly spacing for continuous lines.
analysis_data_filled <- analysis_data %>%
  arrange(Time)
scenario_b_axis_breaks <- seq(as.Date("2010-01-01"), as.Date("2026-01-01"), by = "2 years")

# Temporary daily-calendar highlight used until the Scenario B rule plots are revised.
highlight_points <- analysis_data_filled %>%
  filter(Month %in% c(1, 2))

# Plot of filtered rules on full series
post_rules_line_plot <- ggplot(analysis_data_filled, aes(x = Time, y = .resid)) +
  geom_line(color = "#00BFC4") +
  geom_point(data = highlight_points, 
             aes(x = Time, y = .resid, color = .resid > 10), size = 0.5) +  
  labs(title = "Residual Plot: <span style='color:#9900D0'><b>Extreme</b></span> vs <span 
       style='color:#F8666D'><b>Non-extreme</b></span> values",
       x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Variable") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#F8766D", "TRUE" = "#C77CFF")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y",
                   expand = c(0.02, 0.02)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_markdown())

#------------All Filters Actual Vs Predicted------------
# Create the plot
actual_predicted_plot <- ggplot(analysis_data_filled, aes(x = Time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Value, color = "Actual"),  na.rm = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = .fitted, color = "Fitted"), 
            alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  add_fitted_points_func(list_of_dfs, color_string, 
                                      c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 16)) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "#4682B4", "Fitted" = "#FF8C00")) +
  labs(title = "<span style='color:#4682B4'><b>Actual</b></span> &
       <span style='color:#FF8C00'><b>Fitted</b></span> Simulated Demand",
       x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Variable") +
  scale_x_date(breaks = scenario_b_axis_breaks, date_labels = "%Y",
               expand = c(0.02, 0.02)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = min(test_set$Time, na.rm = TRUE), color = "red",
             linetype = "dotted", size = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_markdown(size = 10))

actual_predicted_plot

# Create the plot
residual_plot <- ggplot(analysis_data_filled, aes(x = Time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = .resid, color = "Actual"),  na.rm = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  add_resid_points_func(list_of_dfs, color_string, # Generate geom_point layers
                                      c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 16)) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "#00BFC4")) +
  labs(title = analysis_target_label, x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Variable") +
  scale_x_date(breaks = scenario_b_axis_breaks, date_labels = "%Y",
               expand = c(0.02, 0.02)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = min(test_set$Time, na.rm = TRUE), color = "red",
             linetype = "dotted", size = 1) + theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_markdown(size = 10)) 
residual_plot

two_plots <- grid.arrange(actual_predicted_plot, residual_plot, ncol = 1)
# Export the series with TreeAlert-flagged rules, consistent with the empirical examples.
ggsave(file.path(simulation_image_dir, "scenario_b_rule_visualization.png"),
       plot = two_plots, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 800)
```
